evidence_items.explanation: The account describes Claude Sonnet 3.7 using search, notes, Slack, and price-setting tools over a month, with humans providing physical services. I infer from this documented implementation that sustained action-taking did not require the asserted new mathematical foundations.

The engineering description explains how ordinary model calls and feedback can produce agent behavior. It corroborates the implementation reading but does not independently demonstrate multi-day performance.

unresolved_gaps: There is no formal determination that Project Vend satisfied every capability OpenAI might intend by level 3.
The sources do not settle whether the system had subjective experience.
